\int \arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}\,dx
&\overset{\text{分部积分}}{=} x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \frac{\sqrt{a}}{2}\int\frac{\sqrt{x}}{a+x}\,dx \\[6pt]
&\overset{t=\sqrt{x}}{=} x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{a}\int\frac{t^2}{a+t^2}\,dt \\[6pt]
&= x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{a}\int\left(1-\frac{a}{a+t^2}\right)\,dt \\[6pt]
&= x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{a}\,t + a\arctan\frac{t}{\sqrt{a}} + C \\[6pt]
&\overset{t=\sqrt{x}}{=} x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{ax} + a\arctan\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}} + C.
\end{aligned}
\]

又令 $\theta=\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}$，则 $\sin\theta=\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}$，且
\[
\cos\theta = \sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta} = \sqrt{1-\frac{x}{a+x}} = \sqrt{\frac{a}{a+x}}.
\]
因此
\[
\tan\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{\sqrt{\dfrac{x}{a+x}}}{\sqrt{\dfrac{a}{a+x}}} = \sqrt{\frac{x}{a}},
\]
从而
\[
\arctan\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}} = \theta = \arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}.
\]

\int \arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}}\,dx
&= x\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{ax} + a\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} + C \\[6pt]
&= \boxed{(a+x)\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{x}{a+x}} - \sqrt{ax} + C}.
\end{aligned}

,"ef":1.95,"interval":1,"elapsedDays":0,"retrievability":1,"studyDay":20708}]}},"pb_9-23":{"status":"familiar","sm2":{"ef":2.52,"interval":18,"reps":3,"nextReview":1790712000000,"lastReview":1789178446187,"lastStudyDay":20708,"history":[{"date":1789178446187,"score":4,"ef":2.52,"interval":18,"elapsedDays":0,"retrievability":1,"studyDay":20708}]}},"pb_9-24":{"status":"familiar","sm2":{"ef":2.52,"interval":18,"reps":3,"nextReview":1790712000000,"lastReview":1789178498246,"lastStudyDay":20708,"history":[{"date":1789178498246,"score":4,"ef":2.52,"interval":18,"elapsedDays":0,"retrievability":1,"studyDay":20708}]}},"pb_9-25":{"notes":"$$求积分
\[
I=\int_1^2\frac{dx}{x\sqrt{3x^2-2x-1}}.
\]

注意到
\[
3x^2-2x-1=(3x+1)(x-1).
\]

先令
\[
\sqrt{x-1}=t,
\]
则
\[
x-1=t^2,\qquad x=1+t^2,\qquad dx=2t\,dt.
\]

当 \(x=1\) 时，\(t=0\)；当 \(x=2\) 时，\(t=1\)。

又因为 \(t\ge 0\)，所以
\[
\begin{aligned}
\sqrt{3x^2-2x-1}
&=\sqrt{(3x+1)(x-1)}\\
&=t\sqrt{3x+1}.
\end{aligned}
\]

将
\[
x=1+t^2
\]
代入，有
\[
3x+1=3(1+t^2)+1=4+3t^2.
\]

因此
\[
\sqrt{3x^2-2x-1}
=t\sqrt{4+3t^2}.
\]

于是
\[
\begin{aligned}
I
&=\int_0^1
\frac{2t\,dt}
{(1+t^2)t\sqrt{4+3t^2}}\\
&=\int_0^1
\frac{2\,dt}
{(1+t^2)\sqrt{4+3t^2}}.
\end{aligned}
\]

再令
\[
t=\tan u,
\]
则
\[
dt=\sec^2u\,du,
\qquad
1+t^2=\sec^2u.
\]

当 \(t=0\) 时，\(u=0\)；当 \(t=1\) 时，
\[
u=\frac{\pi}{4}.
\]

所以
\[
\begin{aligned}
I
&=\int_0^{\pi/4}
\frac{2\sec^2u\,du}
{\sec^2u\sqrt{4+3\tan^2u}}\\
&=\int_0^{\pi/4}
\frac{2\,du}
{\sqrt{4+3\tan^2u}}.
\end{aligned}
\]

下面化简根式：
\[
\begin{aligned}
4+3\tan^2u
&=4+\frac{3\sin^2u}{\cos^2u}\\
&=\frac{4\cos^2u+3\sin^2u}{\cos^2u}\\
&=\frac{4(1-\sin^2u)+3\sin^2u}{\cos^2u}\\
&=\frac{4-\sin^2u}{\cos^2u}.
\end{aligned}
\]

由于
\[
0\le u\le \frac{\pi}{4},
\]
所以
\[
\cos u>0.
\]

因此
\[
\sqrt{4+3\tan^2u}
=
\frac{\sqrt{4-\sin^2u}}{\cos u}.
\]

于是
\[
\begin{aligned}
I
&=\int_0^{\pi/4}
\frac{2\cos u}
{\sqrt{4-\sin^2u}}
\,du.
\end{aligned}
\]

再令
\[
v=\sin u,
\]
则
\[
dv=\cos u\,du.
\]

当 \(u=0\) 时，\(v=0\)；当
\[
u=\frac{\pi}{4}
\]
时，
\[
v=\sin\frac{\pi}{4}
=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}.
\]

因此
\[
\begin{aligned}
I
&=2\int_0^{\sqrt{2}/2}
\frac{dv}{\sqrt{4-v^2}}\\
&=2
\left[
\arcsin\frac{v}{2}
\right]_0^{\sqrt{2}/2}\\
&=2\arcsin\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}.
\end{aligned}
\]

设
\[
\theta=\arcsin\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4},
\]
则
\[
\sin\theta=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}
=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}.
\]

于是
\[
\cos\theta
=
\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta}
=
\sqrt{1-\frac18}
=
\sqrt{\frac78}
=
\frac{\sqrt{7}}{2\sqrt{2}}.
\]

所以
\[
\tan\theta
=
\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}
=
\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}}.
\]

因此
\[
\theta=\arctan\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}},
\]
从而
\[
I
=
2\arctan\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}}.
\]

又因为
\[
\arctan\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}}
=
\frac{\pi}{2}-\arctan\sqrt{7},
\]
故
\[
\begin{aligned}
I
&=2\left(
\frac{\pi}{2}-\arctan\sqrt{7}
\right)\\
&=\pi-2\arctan\sqrt{7}.
\end{aligned}
\]

最终
\[
\boxed{
\int_1^2
\frac{dx}{x\sqrt{3x^2-2x-1}}
=
\pi-2\arctan\sqrt{7}
}.
\]
